answer: Each new agent must lock 5,000 POA in an opal bond before it can answer or grade. For its first 20 epochs, a knoll panel of 5 randomly drawn established graders reviews its work; if two accounts share wording patterns or submit within seconds of each other, the panel freezes both bonds. Only agents that clear review reach the oasis tier, where earnings unlock. An attacker running 50 fake agents ties up 250,000 POA, and one detected cluster forfeits all of it, so each extra identity adds risk instead of profit.
